explication: Godot is a cross-platform 2D/3D game engine with an integrated editor and platform export. The main user journey is creating a project in the editor, running it through the engine, and exporting the game. The graph includes major documented product areas and selected internal components supported by the source index; many subsystem links are not shown because the available source excerpts do not establish their runtime wiring.
